About FEMZN

FEMZN is a Dutch wellness brand created for women who want to feel balanced, energized and connected to their bodies. Our mission is simple: help as many women as possible improve their hormonal balance through education, lifestyle and natural supplements.

Our flagship product, FEMZN Hormonal Support, contains carefully selected plant extracts such as Vitex (Chasteberry), Maca, Rhodiola, Schisandra and Reishi. We also provide educational content, hormone guides and community events focused on women's wellbeing.

What makes us different?

• Female-founded and built from personal experience
• Focused on hormonal balance and women's health
• Premium natural ingredients and transparent formulations
• Strong community-driven brand with educational content
• More than a supplement: a complete wellness approach

How affiliates can earn

• Earn commission on every sale generated through your unique affiliate link or discount code
• Access to exclusive campaigns, promotions and product launches
• Opportunities for long-term ambassador partnerships

How to promote FEMZN

• Share your personal experience with the products
• Create authentic content on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or blogs
• Educate your audience about hormone health, wellbeing and self-care
• Use your personal affiliate link and discount code

Other information

We love working with creators, wellness enthusiasts, yoga teachers, coaches and women who are passionate about health and self-development. Our goal is to build a community that inspires women to prioritize their wellbeing and feel their best every day.

Join the FEMZN movement and help us empower women from the inside out. 🤍
